title: Claude Large moves to Opus 5
summary:
Opus 5 joined the Claude aliases, community models gained readable titles, and quest reward scans got sturdier.

`claude-large` now routes to Claude Opus 5, with `claude-opus-5` added as an alias. Reasoning remains opt-in, and access remains paid-only.

Creators can give a community model a display title separate from its callable slug and description. The catalog, model cards, form, CLI, and API docs now reflect the field; older models retain fallback titles.

Reward recording no longer hits the database parameter limit on scans with many earned rewards. It still records only new rewards; claiming Pollen remains a separate step.

daily.title: Claude Opus 5
daily.text: Use `claude-opus-5` or `claude-large` for Opus 5, with reasoning available when requested. Access remains paid-only. [Browse the model](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models?q=claude-opus-5).

daily.title: Titles for community models
daily.text: Give your community model a display title without changing the slug used to call it. Set the title in the model form or with `polli my-models`.
